ValidationRule.description: The phone number cannot be set to 8447078800 (EverQuote phone line's main number)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
/*The nested SUBSTITUTE functions sequentially remove common formatting characters: (, ), -, + and (space) from the value entered in the various phone field. The resulting string, which should only contain digits, is then evaluated by the REGEX function for the forbidden phone number */
OR( REGEX( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE(Phone, '(', ''), ')', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', ''), '.*8447078800.*' ), REGEX( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( Alt_Phone__c , '(', ''), ')', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', ''), '.*8447078800.*' ), REGEX( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( Alt_Phone_2__c , '(', ''), ')', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', ''), '.*8447078800.*' ), REGEX( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( AssistantPhone , '(', ''), ')', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', ''), '.*8447078800.*' ), REGEX( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( HomePhone , '(', ''), ')', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', ''), '.*8447078800.*' ), REGEX( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( OtherPhone , '(', ''), ')', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', ''), '.*8447078800.*' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Phone number 844-707-8800 cannot be in any phone field
